# V.T.Thanh - Van Trung Thanh's Home

> Personal portfolio of Van Trung Thanh, an Information Technology student at Ho Chi Minh City Open University with a focus on software development, AI, quality assurance, and DevOps. The site presents his background, selected projects, journal, and contact information.

The primary site is https://vtthanh-home-angular.vercel.app/. Vietnamese is the default language with no language prefix. English pages use /en. Other supported prefixes are /de, /fr, /ja, /zh, /es, /ru, and /kr. The links below use English unless identified otherwise.

Content is available for search indexing and real-time retrieval only, subject to robots.txt. Machine learning model training, bulk downloading, and unauthorized text and data mining are prohibited. This guide does not grant additional access or reuse rights.

Retrieve only the public pages relevant to the user's question and cite the page used. Do not crawl administration pages, including language-prefixed administration pages, or paths under /api/ and /actuator/. Do not submit contact forms or invoke the chat service as part of content discovery.

The site uses JavaScript to render its pages. Journal content can change; verify published information on the linked page. If a detail is absent or a page cannot be read, state that limitation instead of inventing information.

## Public portfolio

- [Home](https://vtthanh-home-angular.vercel.app/en): Introduction and professional interests in software architecture, quality assurance, continuous improvement, and DevOps.
- [About](https://vtthanh-home-angular.vercel.app/en/about): Biography, education, experience, and the CV viewer.
- [Projects](https://vtthanh-home-angular.vercel.app/en/projects): Selected projects, technology stacks, source repositories, and available live demonstrations. Includes AIJMC, AIJMC-JPRA, MBMS, AI-Generated Text Detector, ERM, and Sports Venue Booking.
- [Journal](https://vtthanh-home-angular.vercel.app/en/blog): Published articles and personal milestones. Articles may contain multiple chapters; the journal may be empty when no articles are published.
- [Contact](https://vtthanh-home-angular.vercel.app/en/contact): Public contact information and a contact form for visitors.
